content: Qeeseta halaqay Isttifaanose, «Hayssi ne bolla shiiqida yo7ozi tumee?» gi oychchides.
Isttifaanosikka, «Ta ishatoo! Ta aawatoo! Ta gizayssa siyite! Nu aawa Abrahaamey Kaaraane geetettizaso yaanaappe kase buro Mesphexoomiyan dishin bonchcho Goday izas qonccidi,
‹Ne dereppenne ne dabbofe shaakettada ta nena bessizaso ba› gides.
Izikka Kaladaaweta biittafe kezidi Kaaraane geetettiza biittan uttides. Iza aaway hayqqidaappe guye intte ha7i dizaso ha dere iza ehides.
Haray attoshin issi tohoy eqqiza gadey izas hayssafe imettibeenna; gido attiin he wode izas issi naykka baynda dishin izinne izappe guyen iza zereththi biittayo laattana mala Xoossi izas caaqqides.
Qasseka Xoossi izas, ‹Ne zereththi allaga biittan bete as gidana. Oyddu xeetu layth aylleteththa qambara giddon waayettana.
Gido attiin istta aylle mala haariza dere ta qaxxayana; hessafe guye istti he biittafe kezidi hanno ha sohoyin taas goynnana› gides.
Hessafe guye qaxxara woga caaqo izas immides; Abrahaameykka Yisaaqa yelidi iza osppunththa gallas qaxxarides; Yisaaqaykka Yaaqoobe yelides; Yaaqoobeykka tammanne nam7u qommota yelides.
«He qommota aawati Yooseefe bolla qanaatidi iza aylleteththas duge Gibxe bayzida; gido attiin Xoossi izara dees.
Meto ubbaafe iza ashshides; Gibxe kawo Paaroone sinththan bonchcho immides; Paarooney iza Gibxe biittaninne ba keeththa asa ubbaa bolla alaafeteththan shuumides.
«He wode Kanaaneninne Gibxen daro meto ehida gita koshay dendides. Nu aawataska miza kaththi dhaydes.
Yaaqoobey Gibxe deren kaththi dizayssa siyidi nu aawata koyro Gibxe yeddides.
Istti nam7anththo biza wode Yooseefey izi oonakko bana ba ishatas qonccisides. Paarooneykka Yooseefe ishata erides.
Hessafe guye Yooseefey kiittidi ba aawa Yaaqoobenne laappun tammanne ichchashu gidiza ba dabbota kumeth ehisides.
Yaaqoobey duge Gibxe wodhdhides. Izikka nu aawatikka wuri heen hayqqida.
Istta ahaykka Seekeeme geetettizaso efiin Abrahaamey Emoore naytappe ba miishshan shammida duufon moogettides.
«Xoossi Abrahaames caaqqida qaalay polettiza wodey matishin Gibxen diza nu asaa qooday dari dari bides.
Hessafe guye Gibxe biittan Yooseefe erontta hara kawoy kawotides.
Izikka nu asaa ba gene ooson metoththides; buro yelettida guuththa nayti hayqqana malanne asay yelida nayta kare kessi wora yeggana mala wolqqaththides.
He wode Musey yelettides; izikka Xoossa achchan dosettida mala lo7o naa gidides; ba aawaa keeththan heedzdzu agina al7ison diccides.
Izi wora yegettida wode kawo Paaroone macca naya demmada baas ekkadus; ba naa mala ooththada dichchadus.
Museykka Gibxeta aadho erateththaa ubbaa tamaardes; Yo7on era; oosonkka mino gidides.
«Muse layththay oyddu tammu gidida wode Musey ba ishata Isra7eele nayta beyanaas ba wozinan qoppides.
Izikka issi Gibxe asi Muse bagga asaappe issaade bolla qoho gaththishin be7idi ba bagga addeza maaddides; Gibxe addeza wodhidi qohettidayssa halo kessides.
Muses Xoossi iza kushen istta wozzanayssa iza asay akeekizaa misatides; gido attiin istti hessa yuushshi qoppibeettenna.

Wonteththa gallas qasseka Isra7eele naytappe nam7ati ba giddon ooyettishin gakkidi ooyettizayta giigsanaas koyidi, ‹Hayto asatoo! Intte intte garsan issoy issaara ishantta; intte waanidi issoy issaa qoheetii?› gides.

«Ba laggeza bolla qoho gaththidayssi Muse sugi yeggidi, ‹Nena nu bolla nuna haarizaadenne nu bolla pirdizaade ooththi shuumiday oonee? Woykko qamma Gibxe addeza wodhoyssaththo tanakka wodhana koyay?› gides.
Musey hessa siyida mala Midiyaame biitta betidi heen bete as gidi de7ides; Yaankka nam7u attuma nayta yelides.
«Hessafe oyddu tammu layththafe guye Siina zumaa achchan diza bazzo biittan qeeri wora giddon eexxiza tama lacon kiitanchchay izas beettides.

Museykka iza be7ida mala malalettides; aazakko shaakki eranaas izi hee izakko shiiqishin Godaa qaalay, ‹Tani ne aawantta Xoossaa; Abrahaame, Yisaaqanne Yaaqoobe Xoossa› gishin siyides. Museykka daro dagammides; xeellanaaska xalibeenna.

«Godaykka izas, ‹Hayssi ne eqqidasoy geeshshasoho gidida gishshas ne tohoppe caamma shodda; Gibxen diza ta dereta waaye ta tumappe beyadis; istti waassiza waaye waasoza ta siyada istta ashshanaas wodhdhadis; ha7ikka ne haa ya; ta nena duge Gibxe zaarada kiittana› gides.

«Histtiin heyti, ‹Nu bolla nena haarizaadenne pirdizaade histti ooni shuumidee?› giidi asay kase kadhida Muse Xoossi qeeri wora giddon izas beettida kiitanchchaza baggara istta haarizaadenne ashshizaade histtidi isttako zaari yeddides.
Izikka istta kaaleththidi Gibxeppe kessides; Gibxen, Zo7o abbaninne bazzo biittan oyddu tammu layth daro malalisiza miishshatanne gita malaatata isttas ooththides.
«Isra7eele naytas, ‹Ta mala nabe Xoossi intte giddofe denththana› gidayssi hayssa Musekko!
Izikka Siina zuma bolla haasayda kiitanchcharanne bazzo biittan nu aawatara dere duulata giddon dees; de7o qaalakka haa nuus aaththanaas ekkides.
«Nu Aawati gidikko izara eqettida attiin izas azazettanaas koyontta gishshas ba wozinara guye Gibxe simmida.
Aarooneska, ‹Nu sinththara biza eeqa nuus giigsa! Nuna Gibxeppe kaaleththi kessida Musey waanidaakko nu erokko› gida.
He wode mara misle medhdhidi eeqas yarsho shiishshida; barkka medhdhida ba kushe ooson ufayettidi guppida.
«Gido attiin Xoossi isttas zokko zaarides; istti salo xoolinttetas goynnana mala aaththi immides; hessika nabeta maxaafan,
«Xoossi Muse bessida leemisoza malanne azazidayssa mala oosettida Xoossi asara gaaggiza dunkaaneya nu aawatara bazzo biittan de7adus.
Nu Aawati dunkaaneyo ekkidayssafe guye Xoossi Iyaaso kaaleththiin kase istta gooddida dereta laattida wode dunkaaneyo ekki gelida; Dawite wode gakkanaas dunkaaneya he biittan de7adus.
Dawitikka Xoossa sinththan bonchcho demmidi Yaaqoobe Godaas aqoso giigsanaas woossides.
Gido attiin Solomooney izas aqoso keexxides.
«Gido attiin wogga Goday asa kushey keexxida keeththan deenna; hessika nabey kase Geeshsha maxaafan xaafida mala,
gees Godaa Xoossay.
«Intteno wozina muumetoo! Hayththa tulletoo! Intteka intte aawata mala ubba wode Xillo Ayanara eqetteeta.
Nabetappe intte Aawati gooddontta nabey oonee? Xilloza Yohannisa kaseti yootida nabetakka wodhida; intteka ha7i iza aaththi immidetanne wodhideta.
Kiitanchcha baggara inttes imettida woga ekkideta attiin naagibeekketa» gides.
Shuchchan Cadetti Isttifaanose Hayqo
Duulatan diza asay hessa siyida mala daro hanqettidi iza bolla ba achchi garccides.

Gido attiin Isttifaanosi Xillo Ayanan kumidi pude salo tishshi histti xeellishin Xoossa bonchchon Yesusi Xoossa ushachchan eqqidayssa be7idi, «Hekko ta saloy doyettidayssanne Asa Nay Xoossa ushachchan eqqidayssa beyays» gides.
He wode asay qaala dhoqqu histti waassishe ba hayth tucci oykkidi izakko issife woxxides.
Isttifaanose oykkidi katamappe kare olida; shuchchan cach oykkida; hessi wuri hanishin markkatikka ba may7o Sa7oole geetettiza panththaza achchan woththida.
Istti shuchchara iza caddishin Isttifaanosi, «Ta Godaa Yesusaa! Ta shemppoyo neekko ekka» giidi woossides.
Qasseka gulbatidi dhoqqa qaalan «Godoo! Haytantta nagara qoodoppa» giidi waassides; hessa gidaappe guye hayqqides.
